newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai sugar season to end soon, only one mill open.
newsitem.headline: Thai sugar season to end soon, only one mill open.

text.p: Thailand's sugar crushing season is likely to end soon on a lower-than-expected supply of sugar cane as only one of the 46 mills remained in operation, industry sources said on Thursday.
As of May 13, a total of 56.19 million tonnes of sugar cane was crushed to produce 5.79 tonnes of sugar compared with 5.98 million tonnes during the same period last year, they told Reuters.
"Only Mitr Phol mill was still open. During the same period last year, about 10 mills were still in operation. The season will end pretty fast this year," an official at the industry ministry said.
Last year, when Thailand produced around 6.03 million tonnes of sugar, the crushing season ended in June.
"Obviously, this year output might not even reach the last year's level, let alone 6.28 million tonnes earlier projected by the government," the official said.
